tasks.description: Monitor the Water Usage Efficiency (WAI) and trigger a flag if the current value deviates significantly from the historical mean, indicating potential irrigation system leaks or over-watering.
Evaluate the Temperature-Humidity Index (THI) against predefined crop-specific stress thresholds to provide real-time alerts for environmental heat stress.
Calculate the moving average of the Nutrient Balance Ratio (NBR) to detect long-term soil nutrient depletion trends and suggest optimal fertilizer application timing.
Analyze the Photosynthesis Potential (PP) index relative to current growth stages to determine if sunlight exposure is sufficient for the current crop development phase.
Monitor the Frost_Risk index and ambient temperature to generate an immediate alert when conditions reach a critical threshold for the current growth stage.
